# Acceptance fixture: Singing capacitor

> **Singing capacitor**  
> Certain types of ceramic capacitors emit an audible sound when an alternating voltage is applied across them. Investigate the characteristics of the sound produced and how they depend on relevant parameters, such as voltage, frequency, and capacitor properties.

## Structural expectations

- Trace voltage to electromechanical source, mechanical response, acoustic radiation, and measured sound.
- Branch between board-mounted and free-body apparatus.
- Include a constitutive relation, structural model, and acoustic mapping or an explicit unresolved gap.
- Preserve nonlinear, harmonic, and DC-bias predictions.
- Downgrade electrical-only and structural-only explanations as complete models while retaining their component value.
- Name and explain every filtered candidate.

This fixture tests reasoning structure only. It is not a literature source and does not fix the final scientific conclusion.
